fact: BRD, through Hanga Ventures Ignite under the World Bank-backed Rwanda Digital Acceleration Project, has committed over EUR 2 million to 28 homegrown technology startups since April 2025, with over EUR 1 million deployed.
title: The Development Bank of Rwanda (BRD) has, through Hanga Ventures Ignite, committed over EUR 2 million to 28 homegrown technology startups
